scoring_justification: Peierls parameters recomputed from submitted curve; phonon stability checked by sign of frequencies; band gaps compared to thresholds from paper (Fig.4, main text).

hidden_assets.purpose: Acceptable ranges for Peierls BLA and energy gain, and band gap thresholds
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper: BLA approx 0.02 nm, energy gain approx 4 meV/Te, with conservative margins; band gap separation ~0.1 eV
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's reported physical values, verified by the reference oracle.

LC_vac_phonon_freqs.description: Phonon frequencies (cm⁻¹ or THz) for LC in vacuum

ZZ_vac_phonon_freqs.description: Phonon frequencies for ZZ in vacuum

energy_meV_per_Te.description: Total energy per Te atom (meV) for each BLA

LC_PD_equilibrium_BLA_nm.description: Equilibrium BLA from the Peierls curve

LC_PD_energy_gain_meV.description: Energy gain per Te atom due to Peierls distortion (meV)

band_gap_LC_eV.description: Electronic band gap of encapsulated LC (eV)

band_gap_ZZ_eV.description: Electronic band gap of encapsulated ZZ (eV)

outputs.description: Consolidated results for phonon stability, Peierls distortion, and electronic band gaps.

output_contract.notes: All frequency lists are numeric arrays; units may be cm⁻¹ or THz, but must be consistent within each list. The Peierls curve object must have equal-length arrays for BLA_nm and energy_meV_per_Te. The equilibrium BLA and energy gain are single numeric values. Band gaps are floats in eV. The checker will apply tolerance-based comparisons and will not require exact numerical agreement with a specific reference; results that satisfy the qualitative physical criteria will score fully.

steps.description: LC_vac and ZZ_vac must contain at least one negative frequency; LC_enc, ZZ_enc, and 3H_enc must contain no negative frequencies.
Recompute equilibrium BLA and energy gain from LC_PD_curve. BLA must be in [0.015,0.025] nm; energy gain must be in [2,6] meV/Te.
band_gap_LC_eV < 0.1 eV (metallic); band_gap_ZZ_eV > 0.1 eV and band_gap_3H_eV > 0.1 eV (semiconducting).
